lignes.zh: 古时候，有的人生来就是奴隶。
lignes.pinyin: gǔ shí hou yǒu de rén shēng lái jiù shì nú lì
lignes.en: In ancient times, some people were born slaves.

lignes.zh: 他们每天干活，没有自由。
lignes.pinyin: tā men měi tiān gàn huó méi yǒu zì yóu
lignes.fr: Ils travaillaient tous les jours, sans liberté.
lignes.en: They worked every day, without freedom.

lignes.zh: 现在，这样的事已经成为历史了。
lignes.pinyin: xiàn zài zhè yàng de shì yǐ jīng chéng wéi lì shǐ le
lignes.en: Today, such things belong to history.

glossaire.en: to work, to do manual work
